metaDescription: Order custom patriotic lanyards & badges for events or employee IDs. Perfect for 4th of July, veterans, and more. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Custom patriotic lanyards and badges let you show pride at corporate events, trade shows, or employee appreciation days. Choose red, white, and blue designs with stars or stripes to complement your branding. The 3/4" full color lanyard with plastic clamshell and O-ring offers a durable, comfortable option for ID badges or keys. Screen printing or full-color dye sublimation ensures your logo stands out against patriotic patterns.
